products.description: This new series of minted bullion bars not only celebrate each Lunar New Year, beginning with the 2024 Year of the Dragon, but also tell legendary stories related to each of the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac –starting with the Legend of the Azure Dragon. products.title: 2025 Lunar Year of the Snake - Legend of the White Snake 10g Silver Bar
products.description: This bar is the second issue in a series of minted bullion which tells the legendary stories related to the 12 animals of the Chinese Lunar Calendar. In 2025 we tell the story of the White Snake. After a thousand years of Taoist training, the white snake Bai Suzhen was granted the power to become a human woman. She then searched for Xu Xian to repay him for his bravery that saved her in a past life. They soon fell in love and married. But the monk Fahai discovered her identity and convinced Xu Xian to trick his wife into revealing her true form, and he died of shock. Desperate, Bai Suzhen stole an immortal herb from Heaven and revived him. Fahai found the couple and imprisoned Bai Suzhen in a fortress pagoda where she gave birth to a son. Once grown, he freed his mother, and the family was happily reunited. Housed in a brilliant red CertiPAMP™ assay card accompanied by a gift sleeve this 10g 999.0 pure silver bar has a beautiful proof-like finish and is individually serialized.

products.title: America the Free; Liberty Bell Gold Minted Bar - 1oz
products.description: This engraved, 1oz 999.9 pure gold bar is the third in a series of gold bars capturing the essence of America the Free. The bell is famous for its large crack, which likely developed in the early 19th century. It bears the inscription, "Proclaim LIBERTY Throughout all the Land unto all the Inhabitants thereof," reflecting its connection to the ideals of freedom and democracy. PAMP’s highly popular series of Lunar Calendar ingots in fine gold or silver celebrates the traditions of the Chinese New Year with unexpected designs that delight and captivate, from reverse-to-obverse. The brilliant red CertiPAMP™ assay packaging presents each annual ingot as the ideal new year gift for others, or to collect for the self.

products.title: PAMP Suisse Gold Minted Bar - 1oz
products.description: This bar’s reverse side design is a simple repeating "Suisse" pattern. The obverse side in white bears the accredited assayer’s official signature because PAMP quality begins at the assay facilities, supervised by sworn assayers accredited by the Swiss Federal Bureau for the Control of Precious Metals. The assay card packaging also carries an individual serial number, which is also stamped on the obverse side of the bar. As with all PAMP minted ingots, the PAMP Suisse bar is secured within high quality CertiPAMP™ assay-card packaging, which is further protected by a thin removable film. PAMP is the only bullion brand to include a removable film to protect its high-quality assay-card packaging from blemishes such as scratches during shipment.

products.title: PAMP Suisse Gold Minted Bar - 1oz (new)
products.description: The newly redesigned PAMP Suisse 999.9 1oz fine gold ingot is produced to the highest quality standards and artistry for which the PAMP bullion brand is trusted worldwide. Accredited by the Swiss Federal Bureau, each bar is individually registered and sealed within protective CertiPAMP™ packaging with an integrated and official Assay Certificate that guarantees the fine precious metal content and weight, protected with a removable film. The reverse side design is adapted from PAMP’s original founding logo recorded within its archives, distinguished by a central square framing the world-famous hallmark of four initialized dies that together form the PAMP name. Minted with a Brilliant Uncirculated bullion finish, the PAMP Suisse 1oz gold ingot shimmers with light-refracting micro-ridges emanating from the center. As a security feature, advanced laser technology is used to micro-engrave ‘PAMP Suisse’ continuously along the centered, square border, visible only when viewed through a magnifying glass or jeweler’s loupe.
